name: agent-k
description: Standalone Electron desktop client for the Pi coding agent
author: AgentK contributors

scripts.build: npm run prepare:native && npm run build:language-servers && npm run build:desktop && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: tsc -b && npm run build:editors && vite build
scripts.check: npm run check:web && npm run check:desktop && npm run check:language-servers && npm run check:editors && npm run check:k-plan
scripts.test: npm run build:desktop && npm run build:language-servers && node --test extensions/k-plan/index.test.ts electron/agent/rpc.test.mjs electron/file-formats.test.mjs electron/language-server-registry.test.mjs electron/local-models.test.mjs electron/model-provider.test.mjs electron/mounted-volumes.test.mjs electron/packaging.test.mjs electron/settings.test.mjs electron/skill-hub.test.mjs electron/terminal-profile.test.mjs electron/workspace-watch.test.mjs language-servers/cpp-clangd/cmake-debug.test.ts language-servers/cpp-clangd/debug-session-manager.test.ts language-servers/cpp-clangd/debug-session.test.ts language-servers/cpp-clangd/debug-skill.test.ts language-servers/cpp-clangd/worker.test.ts skills/weather/scripts/weather.test.mjs test/agentKSkillBridge.test.ts test/agentKThemeSkill.test.ts test/agentLoopDetector.test.ts test/conversationHistoryMerge.test.ts test/conversationScrollLayout.test.mjs test/cppProjectOverview.test.mjs test/fileEditorTool.test.ts test/panelLayout.test.mjs test/contextUsage.test.ts test/debugPersistence.test.ts test/debugProviders.test.ts test/debugScopes.test.ts test/messageContent.test.ts test/modelAvailability.test.ts test/piRuntimeCompatibility.test.mjs test/previewPresentation.test.mjs test/projectActivity.test.ts test/projectConsoleControls.test.mjs test/providerAuthRefresh.test.mjs test/providerPayload.test.ts test/runtimeLifecycle.test.ts test/terminalPalette.test.ts test/toolActivity.test.ts
scripts.test:debug:e2e: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.debug.config.ts
scripts.test:local-model:e2e: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.local-model.config.ts
